overview_description.description:
Noosh is the provider of marketing and procurement software for managing print and related marketing spend. For over ten years, NewlineNoosh has provided its print procurement software-as-a-service, Noosh, to enterprises and print outsourcers, enabling them to drive down print costs, improve visibility and control, and ensure brand consistency. 

Based in Silicon Valley, we have offices throughout North America and enjoy partnerships with leading print outsourcers around the world to support global print procurement deployments. Our customers include prominent large enterprises in the financial services, consumer products, retail, government and other sectors. 

Our unique approach to managing print procurement is powered by our Noosh software, the most widely used technology for managing print, direct mail, point-of-sale (POS), branded promotions and related products. Noosh uniquely addresses the requirements of its customers by streamlining two critical print management processes - the procurement and financial “source to pay process” and the marketing “design to delivery process,” thereby providing unparalleled efficiency, visibility, and control which results in significant cost savings and efficiency improvements throughout the print supply chain. With Noosh, everyone involved in the print procurement process, including marketing managers, agencies, print buyers and suppliers, easily interact on the same system using a web browser.

product.name: Noosh Marketing Production Execution Software
product.description: A cloud-based platform that provides visibility and control over marketing campaign production, including cost, quality, time, and sustainability factors.

product.name: Noosh Print Procurement Software
product.description: A software solution for managing print marketing procurement, enabling specification, vendor selection, costing, and production management in a single platform.

product.name: Print Production Sustainability Scores™
product.description: A feature integrated into the Noosh platform that calculates and reports the environmental impact of print marketing materials in real time.

product.name: Supplier Diversity Management
product.description: A capability within Noosh to help marketers identify, evaluate, and manage diverse and minority-owned suppliers in marketing campaigns.

product.name: Marketing Cost Attribution and Analytics
product.description: A system to track, analyze, and report detailed marketing production costs across projects and business units for accurate budget management.
